concept.metaphor_text: A release becomes dependable when independent service supports lock through one explicit dependency key
concept.description: Two blue steel H-like support rails terminate in angled receivers fitted around a forward copper key. Two round mounting eyes in each rail and controlled chamfered edges make the separate machined solids and connector visible.

plan.hypothesis: A release becomes dependable when independent service supports lock through one explicit dependency key
plan.visual_mechanism: Two independently anchored blue steel rails seat around a central copper dependency key. Their broad silhouette is the flat/app-icon core; receiver lips and bore lead-ins are hero construction detail. Satin #245064 steel and #B87E48 copper retain restrained reflections and precise, dependable, calm presentation. No text or backing disc enters the mark. Manrope 700 display and DM Sans 400 text remain the supplied choices for adjacent brand naming and UI. Check the shared core at dashboard/documentation/app-icon scale.
assumptions: These are authored alternatives for visual evaluation; owner artistic acceptance remains unknown

details.feature: Mating key receivers and mounting eyes
details.purpose: Show where the independent rails seat on the key and how the assembly could be anchored
details.intended_scale: Hero and native detail; core silhouette remains recognizable in the flat mark
details.construction: The steel rails are 0.20 units thick from z=0.04 and have two radius-0.055 through bores each. Their receivers follow the copper-key footprint with 0.012 clearance. The copper key extends from z=0.04 to z=0.295, preserving its 0.055 front projection beyond the steel caps. A 0.04-thick rear retaining shoulder occupies z=0 to z=0.04 and extends 0.055 beyond the key outline. Its top contacts the rail backs at z=0.04 with a positive bearing land, so the key cannot pass forward through the opening. It follows only the small key, not the overall mark. Explicit 0.023 chamfer faces join planar caps and bore walls; the thinner retaining shoulder has 0.005 chamfers. All three meshes are closed and consistently wound. No renderer bevel modifier or stored averaged vertex normals are used. Satin roughness 0.35, anisotropy 0.8, tangent [1,0,0], colors, camera, light and sampling stay fixed.
details.deletion_test: Removing the receivers makes the copper key an applied ornament; removing mounting eyes loses attachment plausibility

details.feature: Rear retaining shoulder on the dependency key
details.purpose: Provide a real bearing interface for the visible central key and a restrained stepped edge
details.intended_scale: Hero/native side profile; the broad shared core remains the flat-mark silhouette
details.construction: A copper shoulder following the key outline extends 0.055 outward, from z=0 to z=0.04; its top seats against the steel back faces at z=0.04. The same copper body continues forward through the receiver opening.
details.deletion_test: Without this shoulder, the clearance-fit key has no rear bearing surface against the independent rails.
